ram̐ yam̐ kham̐:oṃ āḥhūm̐/srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /'jig rten khams la mnga' mdzad pa/ /bdud sde dregs pa ma rungs pa/ /du las bskyed cing

tei:div.tei:p: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing*// 'jig rten khams la mnga' mdzad pa// bdud sde dregs pa ma rungs pa// du las bskyed cing duḥl sdud// bdud rnams yongs la dbang bsgyur mchog /bdud pho skos rje drang dkar ni// nag po khram shing thod khrag thogs// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// bdud rta nag po rlung gshog chibs// rais 'ga' bdud g.yag nag po zhon// bdud dmag 'bum phrag du mas bskor// dgra bgegs gnyis po zhe la brnag /stong gsum khyab par sprul pas 'gengs// gang la bab pa phye mar gtong*// 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams dang*// dur khrod mchog gi mchod pa'i sprin// dbang po'i me tog tshil chen spos// zhun chen mar me khrag mkhris dri// sha rus zhal zas rkang gling sgra// thod pa ltag sprod rnga chen dang*// nyon mongs sel byed sman gyi mchog /bde ba skyed pa'i dmar chen po// bza' btung 'dod yon gtor ma'i tshogs// rin chen dar zab go mtshon dang*// gcan gzan rkang 'gro 'dab chags rigs// zhwa gos chas zhugs 'cham stabs dang*// dpa' bo stag chas bswa sgra sgrogs// sna tshogs ru dar spungs se phyar// spyan gzigs rnams kyis thugs dam bskang*// sde brgyad dmag dpon mdzad pa'i tshe// skos rje drang dkar ma lags sam// 'jig rten zo dor mdzad pa'i tshe// yon tan ri bkra ma lags sam// sman gyi srung ma mdzad pa'i tshe// rdo rje bdud 'dul ma lags sam// khyad par snang stong sku bsgom zhing*// rlung sngags sems gsum dbyer med bzlas// rang rig ye nas ma bcos pa// ma rig gnyis 'dzin ru tra bsgral// gnyis snang dbyer med klong du sbyor// mchod pa'i mchog ni 'di yin pas// lha mchog khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*// dam tshig nyams chags yongs su bshags// dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol// phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// de 'dzin skyes bu skyong ba dang*// 'bral med sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub// rten la bzhugs shing skyabs ma zhan// gnas 'di khyed la gnyer du gtad// dgra dang bgegs la phrin las mdzod//

ces pa 'di'ang gnas so yon tan ri bkra bdag la dam tshig gis rjes su 'brang nas 'dir gnas gsar du 'tshol ba'i dus zhig tu/ sngags btsun las 'brel rtsal gyis rten 'dzugs bgyis na snyam pa'i skabs su phrin las bcol ba dge'o// ༈ ya hri/ srid pa gsum la dbang byed cing*// bar snang khams la rtsal 'byin pa// bdud rje yon tan ri bkra dang*// gnod sbyin nor bu g.yu rgyal gnyis// sprul pa zhags thogs zor thogs 'gyed// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung gis// nyams pa can gyi sha dang khrag /sman rag gtor ma gser skyems bcas// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// ma lus rtsad nas brlag pa'i phyir// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa dgos dbang gis padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o// ༈ hrīḥ rta mgrin dbang dang pad 'byung gi /bka' nyan srung ma mthu rtsal can// dge bsnyen rdo rje khro 'bar rtsal// gsol lo mchod do phrin las mdzod// mkhan ming pas so// ༈ lha btsan gsol mchod bzhugs/ hrī/ gdod nas ma skyes stong pa las// rtogs dang ma rtogs cho 'phrul las// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi snang ba byung*// ma rig 'dzin pa'i gzhan dbang gis// nyon mongs rtog pa grangs rnyed kyis// phan gnod srid pa'i lha 'dre shar// tshogs brgyad dbang gis sde brgyad snang*/ khro gtum nga rgyal btsan gyi sde// tsa las skyes zhing tsa la sdud// lha btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal// dmar nag dus mtha'i me dpung bzhin// chibs su phrum dmar rlung gshog chibs// dregs pa yongs kyi dmag dpon byed// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*// sha khrag dmar gyi don snying tshogs// bdud rtsi skyems phud rakta bzhes// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gang bcol las// rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med mdzod// ces lha btsan gyi gsol mchod 'di padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o//

༈ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das phyi nang gi /sde brgyad dregs pa mchod 'os mgron gyur la// bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul bas/ kha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab rten phrin las mdzod// kun bzang nor bu'i gsung bzhin chos kyi bdag pos so// ༈ chos rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag pa las// rten 'byung sgyu ma yid bzhin shar ba'i sprin// da hā u las kun bzang bdug spos ma// mthing mdzes rin chen 'dod yon lnga yis spras// rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus khyab par 'gengs// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi rol mo las// rdul phran re bzhin rdul snyed sgyu 'phrul 'char// ngo mtshar smon lam bcu gnyis mthar phyin zhing*// blta na sdug pa'i zhing khams mdzes pa'i mgon// bai ḍūr rin chen 'od kyi rgyal po mchog sprul pa'i rnam rol o rgyan longs spyod rdzogs// dbyer med sprul sku mkhas grub yon tan mgon// ye shes sgyu ma gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi// gnod sbyin sde dpon rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*// bka' sdod dam can dregs pa'i sde dpon dgu// mngon shes lha sman drang srong ser skya mchod// thugs bskyed smon lam dbang gi skad cig la// yid ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis rjes dgongs la// dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyi rnam sprul zhing*// nyer spyod 'dod yon zag med dgyes mchod kyis// rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga lo ma dang*// me tog 'bras bu ro bcud phun tshogs kyis// rin chen bzang shing phye mar dud sprin 'thibs// cir yang bzhed dgur 'jo ba'i longs spyod 'dis// sku gsum rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags// 'go ba'i lha g.yang mnol ba sor chud nas// mthong ba chung dang thos pa gtam gyi tshig /reg myong rtsa yi rten 'brel la brten nas// dus gsum rgyu 'bras brtag la thogs med cing*// gnyen po ro nus zhu rjes mthu ldan te// rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus nad sel nas// mgon po gang gi phrin las sman gyi tshogs// reg myong 'brel tshad dug lnga'i nad sel zhing*// mdor na dge ba'i yid la smon pa dang*// re ba'i 'bras bu mtha' dag 'grub gyur nas// sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang 'grub par shog

/gso rig 'dzin pa tshe chos mos ngor/ tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa'o/ / ༈ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig rang bzhin rnam dag byang chub sems nyid las// ye shes sgyu mar shar ba'i mchod sprin gyis// rang byung yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas// snod bcud gzung 'dzin dbyings su sbyang ba'i rtsal// gsang rdzas bzang shing gya nor dngos po kun// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bzhu brtul yid bzhin gyi// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas pas// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams kun 'byams klas gyur// hūm̐/ 'og min gsang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs padma thod phreng rtsal// chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir drag por skur bzhengs pa// 'jigs byed dmar nag me yi phreng ba can// padma drag po'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs// thugs rje'i thugs dam dbang gis brtan par bzhugs// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod du 'bul// bdug spos lha mo dmar ser spos khang 'dzin// 'dod lnga'i longs spyod cir yang 'char ba 'dis// ye shes rab 'bar rdo rje phag mo yum// go cha lha lnga khrag 'thung drag rtsal bzhi// bdud 'dul khro bcu sgo skyong khro bo dang*// ging bdud rtsis shan mu ran skyong ma bsang*// sgrub mchog bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas// dam 'khon grib dang mi gtsang nyes pa yis// rtsa gsum lha srung thugs dang 'gal gyur pa'i// nyams chags dri ma thams cad dag sangs zhing*// sgrib med tshangs pa yid bzhin stsal du gsol// bdag ni 'di bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes 'jug pas mi btang zhing*// dbyings kyi dgongs pa g.yel ba mi mnga' bar// thun mong brgyad gnyis mchog gi dngos grub stsol// zhes pa'ang mchog sprul shī la'-i mtshan dang tshe chos mos ngor/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o/ / ༈ e/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid// 'gags med rten 'byung rol pa las// rig pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis// thams cad kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// rdo rje'i lha mo bdug pa mo// rnam mang cir yang 'char ba yi// bde stong zag med bsang mchod 'dis// 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed// phyag rgya zil gnon tshe yi bdag

/dbyings dang sgrol ba'i yum mchog gnyis// tshe 'chi srog gi bdag po gsum// mon pa bzhi dang bdud po bzhi// las kyi 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dang*// zla ba'i gshed po sum cu gnyis// zhag gshed sum brgya drug cu bsang*// nyams chag 'khrul pa dbyings su bshags// mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad zhi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor gong 'phel nas// snang srid skye 'gro'i brtan pa 'phrog byad gdon 'khrul pa tshar chod cing*// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bla ma tshe chos mos ngor padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba'o// ༈ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ stong nyid dbyings las thugs rje'i rtsal// 'gags med snang cha'i rol pa las// dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa'i sprin// rnam 'phrul cir yang 'char ba yis// kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum// rbod gtong ma mo'i dkyil 'khor nas// ḍākki seng ha mu khar bzhengs// gnas dang yul gyi phra men dang*// ma tshogs dbang mo nyi shu brgyad// bka' nyan lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs// bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa dang*// phye mar bzang shing dud pas bsang*// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes// sngags 'chang sgrub mchog bdag cag la// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// phra men ngan sngags mu stegs byad// bsam sbyor log pa'i nyams pa can// ma lus phye mar brlag par mdzod// ces pa'ang kāḥthog sprul shī la'i mtshan can dang tshe ring chos 'phel zung gis mos ngor/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ dur khrod lha mo'i bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs so// bzang shing dang phye mar/ khyad par gyis mthun rdzas 'o chol rnams bshams te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid khros mar gsal ba yis// thugs las 'od zer lcags kyu bzhin// 'phros pas dur khrod gsang lung nas// mkha' 'gro lha mo ngan ne ma// ming sring brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// ma ltar byams pa'i tshul gyis gshegs// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung dang*// bzang shing sman sna dri zhim spos// phye mar zas phud 'o chol rnams// ting 'dzin dag pas byin rlabs pa// 'bul lo ma mo las mkhan mo// bzhes shig rol la dgyes par mdzod// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// sprul pa las kyi ma mo brgyad// ming sring brgyad po mnyes par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa la// sa dang lam gyi bar chad sol// zas nor dkor gyi bdag mo mdzod// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// thams cad ma lus rdul du rlog

cho 'phrul gang bcol phrin las mdzod// ces pa sgrub brtson bla ma dam pa 'chi med bzhed skong du/ padma las 'brel rtsal gyis dpal kaḥthog gi brag seng ge 'dra ba'i rtse nas spel ba dge'o// ༈ skye med dbyings las rang rtsal du// ye shes mdangs las sna tshogs snang*// mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing*// mi mjed dag pa'i zhing gi cha// bye ba phrag brgya ji snyed las// stong gsum bar ma'i bkod pa las// 'dzam bu'i gling gi gnas mchog na// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i khyad par gyis// pre tā pu ri zhes su grags// phyi ltar 'jig rten snang ba'i ngor// ri bo sgam po padma bkod// nang ltar mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bde// dpal chen yang dag he ru ka /ko ri ma mo brgyad kyi tshogs// mkha' 'gro shugs kyi 'du ba'i gnas// btsan rgod mi srun sprul 'khor bcas// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// thugs rje dbang gis 'dir gshegs la// bsang shing spos kyi dud sprin 'thib// gtsang ma phud mchod mtsho ltar bskyil// ga ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod rnams// ting 'dzin yid las rab sprul pa// zag med nam mkha' mdzod lta bur// 'bul na thugs rjes bzhes nas kyang*// thugs dam dgyes par rab skong nas// byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sel// mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong du spel// mi srun skye bo bag med pas// tshod yod 'gal ba'i las byed pa// nyams pa ma lus tshar chod la// las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'ang sgra rgyal 'brug gi lor ri bo sgam po la gnas kyi 'du ba khyad par can gyi dus su bstan pa rgyal mtshan skye srid mchog sprul brtson 'grus rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong du kaḥthog mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtshos spel ba dge'o// ༈ padma ka ra la phyag 'tshal lo// bsang mchod la sman dug rigs med pa'i dri zhim sna tshogs dang*/ shing rtse dri zhim sna tshogs dang*/

ja chang phud ma nyams pa dang*/ phye mar sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ hūm̐/ rang nyid snang srid zil gnon mdun// gnas yul bkod pa lha yi yul// yang lung gnas mchog ru dam yul// gang de'i gnas bdag drag po rtsal// dge bsnyen nor bu g.yul rgyal po// rin chen g.yu yi khang bzang ni// 'khor sa rim pa gsum gyi dbus// rin chen khri steng dar zab steng*// dge bsnyen chen po lha yi chas// dar dang rin chen phung pos brgyan// rgyal po'i chas gsol dar thod mdzes// nor bdag nor bu phyag na bsnams// 'od 'phros gzi brjid ldan par bskyed// g.yas su sras mchog 'dod don 'grub// g.yon du sras mo gnyes mdzes mo// gnyis ka lha yi chas kyis brgyan// mdun du yum mchog 'od 'bar ma// lha mo rin chen brang rgyan can// gser zo bdud rtsi'i gang ba 'dzin// 'khor sa bar ma lha btsan 'bum// tha ma gnyan sde 'bum phrag bdun// bar par klu btsan dregs pa'i tshogs// yang 'khor bod kyi gnas bdag dang*// rgya gar rgya nag gnas srung tshogs// don la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bod 'bangs bde la 'god phyir du// mchod phyir bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// ting 'dzin sprul pa'i zhing mchog 'dir// rang rang 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs// phye mar ja chang 'o zho dang*// 'bras chang rgun chang btung ba dang*// dza ti rnam rgyal ga bur dang*// tsandan dkar dmar a ka ru// du ru ka dang spos dkar dang*// shug pa pur dkar nya brug dang*// 'khan dkar la sogs dri zhim pa'i// rtsa ba lo ma sdong bu dang*// 'bras bu me tog dri zhim rigs// bsreg pa'i rmug sel dud pa 'dis// dge bsnyen nor bu g.yu rgyal bsang*// yum sras blon po'i tshogs bcas bsang*// lha 'khor lha tshogs 'bum phrag bsang*// gnyan 'khor bdun 'bum lha tshogs bsang*// klu 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bsang*// yang 'khor bod kyi gzhi bdag bsang*// mnga' ri skor gsum srung ma bsang*// dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i srung ma bsang*// mdo khams sgang drug srung ma bsang*// brtan ma skyong ma bcu gnyis bsang*// g.ya' ri gangs ri'i ma mo bsang*// gnod sbyin rdo rje sham po dang*// thang lha rdo rje gangs bzang sogs// srid pa'i lha rabs mched dgu bsang*// mkha' ri rdo rje brag skyes dang*// dge bsnyen yul bdag la sogs pa'i// dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig bsang*// spu ri gong rgyal spom ra sogs// rje yi mgu lha bcu gsum bsang*// bsam yas g.yang lung g.ya' ma lung*// brag rdzong ne'u ring rdzong gsum dang*// der lha o rgyan rdzong la sogs// bod kyi gnas chen thams cad bsang*// gnas bdag 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bsang*// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan yang rgya gar rdo rje gdan// bya rgod spungs ba ri bya rkang*// gangs can ri rtse la sogs pa'i// gnas dang gnas bdag 'khor bcas bsang*// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// rgyal po'i khab dang yangs pa can// o rgyan yul dang siṅga la// bal yul kha che zangs gling yul// 'phags yul gnas dang gnas bdag bsang*// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// bsil ba tshal dang bde byed brtsegs// padma brtsegs dang laṅka brtsegs// lhun grub brtsegs dang gsang chen rol// he chen brdal dang 'jig rten brtsegs// dur khrod chen po de dag na// gnas pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// lha klu gnyan btsan ma mo sogs// gnas dang gnas kyi bdag po bsang*// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan yang ri bo rtse lnga dang*// so sor tha dang khri sgo dang*// ljang hu'i pho brang chen po dang*// sman ci ljang yul ha la shan// 'ga' 'ga' gnas dang gnas srung bsang*// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// gzhan yang rgya gar rgya nag dang*// bod yul dbus na gnas pa yi// ming dang mtshan nas ma thon pa'i// mchod 'os mgron 'os mgron rnams la// pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med par bsngo// rang rang gang 'dod ji 'dod pa'i// 'dod pa'i bsam pa rdzogs par bsngo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

ho/ de ltar bsang gis mchod pa'i mthus// gnas bdag gnas srung gzhi bdag sogs/ khyed kyi rmug sgrib sangs gyur cig thugs la phog thug bzod par gsol// 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bshags// bsang zhing bshags pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel bslu med mthus// bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// rgya sog yon dang du ru ka'i// mtha' dmag 'khrugs pa'i ru sna bzlog /dbus dang mtha' mi so mtshams bsrung*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs// 'gro ba'i bde skyid rten 'brel sgrigs// mthar thug gdod ma'i dbyings su 'ub// ces pa 'di ni skyabs mgon rdzogs chen pa'i bka' 'bangs tha shal ba sngags btsun las kyi rdo rjes shar mar spel ba'o// ༈ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yul ni rdzong shod dag pa'i zhing gi dbus// padma'i phrin las gnas mchog padma brag /phyi ltar rigs gsum mgon po sprul pa'i zhing*// nang ltar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// gsang ba rgyud sde dpal gyi bkod pa rdzogs// gang de'i bdag po dpa' bo dbang chen rtsal// bde skyid klu mo 'dod 'byung dpal gyi sras// rin chen thod pa rtsal zhes mtshan gsol ba'i// rin chen rigs 'chang nor lha gter gyi bdag dkar ser zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i lang tsho 'bar// dar zab lhab lhub rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas ru mtshon phyar// rin chen ba gam brtsegs pa'i khri la bzhugs// lha klu gnod sbyin bye ba'i gtso bo che// 'jig rten mi ma yin gyi mnga' bdag nyid// 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su// dpa' bo chen po las kyi rdo rje dang*// dam tshig chen po srog gi sbrel nas kyang*// ci bgyi bka' nyan las byed khas blangs bzhin// deng gi gnas 'dir 'bod do gshegs su gsol// rin chen 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong du bzhugs// khyed la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin tshogs gtib pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// 'dod rgu nam mkha' mdzod kyi char du 'bebs// mi zad rnam mang mdzes pa'i 'dod yon 'khrigs// dme yug nyams grib sel ba'i bsang mchod 'dis// yab gcig dpa' bo dbang chen rtsal dang ni// yum mchog klu mo bde skyid yab yum bsang*// sras mchog rin chen thod pa rtsal zhes bsang*// lcam dral gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs bcas bsang*// lha klu mi ma yin la dbang sgyur bas// khyed kyi 'khor du gtogs pa thams cad bsang*// mchod sbyin dam pa deng 'dir bzhes nas kyang*// sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rang gnyan po 'bul// phyin chad 'grogs pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod// dgra jag chom rkun 'jigs pa'i bar chad sol// mi phyugs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// khyad par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la// bar chad bgegs thal gnod pa'i dgra bo sod// ma nyes kha g.yogs byad phur rbod gtong bzlog

/bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon ngoms// snyan dang grags pa'i ba dan dkar por phyor// 'jig ten lha klu mi min dbang du bsdus// bod khams dkar po'i chos la 'god par mdzod// gzhan yang snyigs mas mnar ba'i 'gro khams la// nad mug mtshon gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// glo bur g.yul 'khrugs dal rims mtha' dag kun// med cing mi 'byung zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces ngag gi dbang po'i gsungs pa'o/ / ༈ hūm̐ hri: sngon tshe padma thod phreng gis// gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams su// dregs pa can rnams ma lus pa// dam btags bka' yi rtsis rgyar bzhag /rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum dang*// ri dbang rgyal po spun dgu dang*// mtha' yi dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig /bka' dang dam tshig rjes dgongs la// bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// khyad par dge bsnyen nyer gcig las// 'jig rten srid pa'i mtshan gsol ba// rā phyor ri bo che zhes grags// mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang thob gsang ba'i mtshan gsaul ba// nor bdag dbang chen drag po rtsal// sku mched rdo rje lam bzang rtsal// sha za mkha' 'gro mched lnga dang*// mtsho sman klu mo nor bzang ma// sras mchog ti se gnyan po dang*// sras mo lha sman tsor po dang*// lha klu bdud btsan gnyan dang bcas// g.yung drung lcags rtse 'khor bcas rnams// de ring bsang gi mgron la byon// dri zhim bzang shing dud sprin gtib// 'bru sna phye mar dar sna dang*// mthun rdzas g.yag lug ra gsum bcas// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pas// gcig las brgya stong grangs med 'phros// yid la 'dod pa kun bskang shing*// nyams chag grib dang rmug 'thib sel// mthu stobs dpal yon so sor bskyed// ki la dga' zhing bswo la dgyes// cha la 'du zhing dgra la rngams// gzhi la 'dug na legs tshogs spel// byes su 'gro na sdong grogs mdzod// bsam pa bsgrub la re ba skong*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces pa'ang bla ma ye shes mi 'gyur ngor padma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis/ ༈ lam lha dang ja phud mchod pa bsam 'grub dpal 'bar bzhugs so// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// mchog thun grub gnyis 'dod 'jo yi dam lha// rnam bzhi'i las sgrub mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// mchod de bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// tshad ma'i skyes bu ston pa sangs rgyas dang*// bslu med yum mchog dam chos yum chen mo// zla med grogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// khyad par skyabs gnas kun 'dus ye shes sku// raba'abyams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsang gsum dngos// khyab bdag o rgyan padma thod phreng rtsal// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// dgongs brda snyan brgyud sau zur gnubs gsum dang*// rong klong rnam gnyis kun mkhyen kaḥthog pa// dam gtsang byams sogs thugs rje'i gter rnams la// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// rang byung 'od gsal byang chub snying po'i sku// yan lag bdun ldan dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gu ru drag po rtsal// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi// khyab bdag tibta tsakra rdo rje sems// gar dgu'i rnam rol badzra ku mā ra// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// mkhyen brtse ye shes sku can 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rnam kun mchog ldan gzugs la rjes chags shing*// 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa ya ma ri// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// srid pa'i chu gter che las nyam thag 'gro// thar ba rin chen gling du thar mdzad pa// thugs rje'i smon lam mthu btsan spyan ras gzigs// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod// mkha' khyab rnam bcas rnam med ldan pa'i gzugs// gang sku srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor nas// phyag rgya chen mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mchod do bsam don lhun grub dpal 'bar mdzod//
bla ma tshe ring chos 'phel lha ldan du bgrod pa ma lam srung 'dod 'grub tu tshul khrims rgya mtshos so/// /
